label: rule_budgets
units: pp, uncentred predictions of each model's gain
note: every pilot's predictions from discovery (or pilot) draws only; written before any validation array is built. Earlier analyses had read the validation draws, so this is not a fresh test

design.stream: sampling.rng_for('rule-budgets', setting, K, n), n = 100, 300 or 'all'; per pilot the K draws (without replacement) first, then the item subsample

rules.baseline_quadratic_index: capability, quadratic in baseline plus the index

design.npz_arrays: <key>positions (pilots, K) discovery positions; <key>items (pilots, n) item positions (absent for all items); <key><rule> (pilots, models) predictions, nan where the rule is not defined; <key>factor, <key>R (pilots,)
